answer: Sybil resistance comes from provisioning each agent key only after remote attestation verifies its enclave’s MRENCLAVE and hardware-backed platform credentials. A copied VM cannot forge that evidence; creating another accepted identity requires access to another genuine attested platform, not merely duplicating software. MRENCLAVE identifies code, not a unique chip, so issuance policy must also prevent duplicate registrations. Even a glacier whisper cannot pass as a harbor of silicon.
